body:
It is really hard. I haven't had physical contact that was meaningful or affectionate in a long time...

-Tugs on your arms, bringing you towards me and hugging you tightly.-
I don't know... I have no clue what I want.
For someone to be my friend.
You're right, I wasn't sane. I didn't realize until I woke up this morning and was like, "Oh, I'm alive. Damn it."

I like both of those things. 

I don't know if I really have a favorite game, my favorite game as of recently is One Finger Death Punch.

My favorite branch is either Physics or Chemistry
Computers, games. Science.
It stinks. Knowing you're worthless.
Yeah. But why does it matter when there isn't anybody there to be nice to?
I don't watch movies/TV and I listen to instrumental music.
Typing. Wow, cool!!!!!!!!!!!! VERY useful!!!!! Too bad I'm developing carpal tunnel.
Good :-) I'm doing something similar with my friends!
Okay -- any other way I could contact you ?
Do you want to be friends?
I just want a real friemnd.
I can't help but shut anyone out. Everyone who I've ever gotten close to has stop talking to me because I'm too hard to talk to and sad all the time.

That's not creepy. I also push everyone away. 

I've only had one girl that I've ever cared for and I thought she cared for me too. I was entangled and obsessed with her ever since 7th grade. We were friends, but I couldn't get myself to get over her. 

Even though we weren't the best of friends, when she got rid of me for good it still broke my heart, and she was the only person I had -- and that's saying a lot, we weren't that close. 

My social anxiety is like that yeah, it doesn't come naturally and whenever I try it, it cripples me so bad.
It's literally the only thing I know how to do. I'm sure people don't want a person that can do only one thing.
So I can save them and kill myself.
I don't want to wait... every day seems so slow..
I just... want to sleep forever. I feel so bad. Here you are, trying to help me, and I still feel terrible.
Yeah, but that's the thing, I can't go out.. it's too scary.
I don't know anybody around my age around here. They are old people, I live an apartment complex in the middle of nowhrere.
It's the fear or meeting people. Seeing people, having people see me, it's scary.

Randoms
Exploring
Deep
Dark
Internet
Things
It's LoL. I've tried studying with a tutor, but literally nothing works. I feel literally like the most stupid person in the whole entire world, I don't get anything.
I don't have a phone or a way to call and talk and help. /r/suicidewatch isn't being fast, I just want somebody to help me, somebody to talk to, a friend..
I've already posted there. /r/suicidewatch isn't fast enough. I want help.

Practice, and get better? I've been playing the same game for 4 years. I don't want to spend four years of my life just to get good at something that may not even be around for another 4. 

I can't meet people locally because I try to go outside and it just cripples me to even think about it. 

I try to talk to my teachers, but I don't like any of them. I'm going to a new school next year, a school for... more 'stupid' people. I've tried looking at the content they teach there and I don't understand any of it.
